A not at all complicated but dangerous quest: go down the many floors of the {wiki:Minotaur Pyramid|Minotaur Pyramid}, northeast of Darashia, fighting your way through minotaurs of every kind. At the bottom, after killing a {creature:Mummy}, you open two coffins with a {item:Stealth Ring} and a {item:Protection Amulet}.
Enough health potions for several minotaur rooms
Kill the minotaurs floor by floor instead of running past them: at the bottom you'll need room to face the Mummy.
The {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages} on the second-to-last floor deal magic damage from a distance; deal with them first.

Travel to **Darashia**: by boat (tell your city's captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s port) or by magic carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}). Leave the city and head **northeast** to the {wiki:Minotaur Pyramid|Minotaur Pyramid}. At ground level you only find {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}.
Go down the stairs. Down there you'll find {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and one or two {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}.
Follow this path **southwest** and go down another stair.
Map 1: path southwest to the stairs
Go **east/northeast**. On this floor there are several {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards} and {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}. Go down the next stair.
Map 2: path east/northeast to the stairs
On the floor below there are minotaurs of every kind, including about 4 {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}.
On this floor, go **north** and look for another stair down. At the bottom a {creature:Mummy} awaits you.
Map 3: path north to the last stairs
Kill the {creature:Mummy} in the final room.
Open the **southeast** coffin to receive the {item:Stealth Ring} and the **northeast** coffin to receive the {item:Protection Amulet}.
Map 4: the coffins with the rewards

To leave, go back the **same way**: climb the stairs you came down (follow maps 3, 2 and 1 in reverse: **south**, then **west/southwest** and finally **northeast**) up to the ground floor of the pyramid. You don't need any item. Then return to Darashia, to the **southwest**.
